key_warnings: Parser could silently drop a complete raw+cleaned pair when an unrelated record (WARNING/status) interleaved between the raw and cleaned prints, or when a log snapshot ended mid-pair (reviewer confirmed by execution on synthetic inputs; the hash-pinned audited artifact was unaffected).

Baseline-manifest generator could claim embedded-code==HEAD on a diff error (vacuous all()), crash instead of recording null-with-reason on unreadable config, and hard-code model IDs plus a static precedence note that could contradict its own computed result.

Privacy scan was extension-only: the snapshot tool's own artifact names (LocalFlow.log.full / .historical-prefix) matched no ignore rule; a two-word verbatim transcript quote sat in the committed reconciliation JSON against the never-transcript-text rule; the snapshot CLI flow was untested; the probe could crash before writing its report.
review_loop.address: All valid M01-scope findings fixed in-session: parser orphaned-raw rescue + EOF flush (audited aggregates re-verified identical afterwards); diff exit-code discrimination + stderr recorded; config reads degrade to null-with-reason; model IDs and precedence note derived from the computed effective config; .gitignore extended (LocalFlow.log.*, v2-evidence/, *.flac, *.m4a, M02 fixture-negation note); content-marker scan over docs/ added to the privacy test; snapshot CLI gains argv injection, in-repo-root refusal and nonzero exit on source mutation, with two new tests; transcript quote reworded and reconciliation JSON regenerated; probe wraps ASR in try/except and labels non-llm modes honestly; registry parsers warn on shape drift and accept 2+-digit IDs; chunked sha256; UTC run id; with-open file handles; version-probe failure reasons; instance.lock moved to unresolved with inference caveat.
